content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the NHB Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 18-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of NHB to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the National Housing Bank (NHB) for filling various officer posts across India for the year 2026-27.

faq.question: Q2. What are the posts available in NHB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The available posts include General Manager, Deputy General Manager, Assistant General Manager, and Manager in various specialized fields like IT, HR, Accounts, Legal, and Company Secretary.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply online for NHB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application and pay the required fees is 18 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for General and OBC candidates?
faq.answer: Candidates other than SC, ST, and PwBD categories are required to pay an application fee and intimation charges totaling ₹850/-.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for SC/ST/PwBD candidates?
faq.answer: Candidates belonging to SC, ST, and PwBD categories need to pay only ₹175/- towards intimation charges.

faq.question: Q6. What qualifications are required for the Manager (Human Resource) post?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Manager (HR) post must hold an MBA or PGDM degree in Human Resources along with minimum post-qualification work experience.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for Manager posts?
faq.answer: The age limit for Manager posts (Scale III) is generally between 25 years and 35 years as per the notification guidelines.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply for the NHB recruitment posts?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online through the official website www.nhb.org.in by navigating to the current vacancies section and filling out the application form.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process includes preliminary screening of applications, a Group Discussion if the applicant pool is large, and a final personal interview.

faq.question: Q10. Where should hard copies of deputation applications be sent?
faq.answer: Printed deputation applications must be sent through proper channel via Speed Post or Registered Post to the DGM (HRMD) at the NHB Head Office in New Delhi.
